scope: SOURCE-ONLY retest coverage inventory; no qualification, execution, integration, winner selection, shared leaderboard mutation or new algorithm. Counts are identities within cohorts, not a deduplicated algorithm count. All historical raw evidence remains authoritative.

new_init_contract.contract: recipe.initialization=batch_feature_zero; make_prior keeps constructor draw then RNG-neutral R2 overwrite; explicit init_std=.5 and shared stream for old tiny host. Supported fresh G/D/E parameters use keys0/1/2; EMA critic synchronized. Supplied priors are not redrawn by make_optimizers. No old tensor fixture load. Preserve old caller data/index/cursor stream separately.
new_init_contract.source: ka2_tests source audit message; executable harness/merged commit must be pinned by root before launch.

ordering_tiers.purpose: Mandatory new-init controls: public K3P, public KA2 defaults, exact previous constant KA2 and diagnostic decay configuration.

Every retained public API alias/package revision, including prior quality failures and incomplete attempts after source preflight. Start with current leading and cheap-screen-near-miss packages; do not drop the rest.

All named research leaderboard leaders/configurations and all scored formulation cohorts. Preserve exact host losses/config; use merged public initializer through a reviewed binding. Research-only does not imply API evidence.
Unresolved old PR aliases, partial/draft/unbound sources. Recover exact identities first; retain NOT_RUN/UNVERIFIED/UNSUPPORTED rather than inventing measurements.

required_separations: Quality verdict, execution completeness, source provenance, API scope and continuous eligibility are independent fields.
No changed initializer run inherits any prior pass, failure or time. Old scores stay immutable, labeled old initialization.
Preserve declared learner horizon/noise/rate policy on the first new-init screen. Scheduled historical passes do not become run-forever qualification.
Constant KA2 must be reconsidered with new init. Its prior prehold61/120 and recovery+120,126/209 record is retained, not a reason to omit it.
Do not conflate public20k/z2/batch2048 recovery with tiny12/z4/batch128 mode_hold. Retain separate scorer and observation streams.
Do not merge K3/P1 implementations, K3P research/API, B3-belief/B3-guarded, RG5 base-floor/.1-floor configurations, API C13/C13-R1, or API RP1 lazy/eager/other package revisions by alias alone.
Retest modified/source-disqualified historical configurations for quality if requested, but mark continuous eligibility separately until source no longer depends on an irreversible horizon policy.
Recovery uses first arrival plus every subsequent failure/minimum/suffix; historical81-check windows are not an acquisition deadline.
No seed sweep; retain fixed task observation/noise seeds. Constructor RNG consumption and data cursors must be proven separately from replacement weights.
quick_screen_plan: Pin merged develop commit, candidate ancestor ZIP/source map, integration diff, new initialization contract and actual initial tensor/buffer hashes. Zero-update construction checks must prove deterministic parameters and correct caller RNG consumption.

Run canonical tiny mode_hold1200 first for every compatible candidate/config; preserve all24 observations and final5 rule. Then intensity600 and/or its formerly binding cheap vector gate, same original task data/losses. This screen is not full qualification.

Investigate improved historical failures by comparing full trajectories, support acquisition, precision events/rates/noise and exact host/source differences; retain failures even if final endpoint improves.
Only each candidate/config that survives its cheap screen earns its own public ring/stationary/repeated-change/checkpoint/API and broader22 continuation, without borrowed source passes.
Retain unsupported custom-host/component bindings as UNSUPPORTED until an exact reviewed public integration exists; do not silently remove objectives to fit GANTrainer.
